sample_unit: outpatients with vertigo or dizziness (prospective clinical evaluation); 227 histories in history-based evaluation

links.outcome: Prospective concordance of agent diagnosis with clinician final diagnosis while clinicians were blinded to agent output
links.effect: Agent matched the reference diagnosis in 140 of 176 (79.55%; 95% CI 72.8%-85.2%) patients, with clinicians blinded to agent output.
links.quote: The conversational agent matched the reference diagnosis in 140 of 176 (79.55%; 95% CI 72.8%-85.2%) patients.

links.outcome: LLM Top-1 accuracy compared with specialist panel majority vote on same vertigo histories
links.effect: Gemini-2.5-pro and o1 reached 69.6% Top-1 vs specialist majority vote 63.9%; no LLM significantly outperformed specialists (McNemar P>.10 for all models).
links.quote: no LLM significantly outperformed the specialist panel majority vote (63.9%, 95% CI 57.3%-70.1%; McNemar test, P>.10 for all models)

unlisted_practices: Local on-premises deployment of LLM within institutional infrastructure
Nurse-assisted tablet-based conversational history-taking by LLM agent

screen.reason: The study prospectively evaluates the diagnostic concordance of a locally deployed, nurse-assisted conversational LLM agent across 5 outpatient clinics, but does not compare outcomes with vs. without a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
